title: AdvisorFailureLogEntry
description: One JSONL entry in .gzkit/insights/advisor-failures.jsonl emitted when the advisor timeout primitive fires.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 timestamp with timezone when timeout occurred

callable_name.description: Name of the callable that timed out

file_paths.description: Files being analyzed when timeout occurred

invocation.description: Whether the advisor was invoked via auto-chain hook or ad-hoc CLI
